hash_definitions.raw_byte_sha256: SHA-256 of the exact on-disk bytes; includes indentation, whitespace and line endings. Existing *_fixture_sha256 fields record bytes observed at adjudication time.
hash_definitions.lf_normalized_sha256: SHA-256 after replacing CRLF with LF; indentation and whitespace still matter. This is NOT canonical JSON content hashing.
hash_definitions.canonical_content_sha256: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON, sorted object keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, no trailing newline. Arrays retain their order. Entire fixture object included.
hash_definitions.fixture_manifest_content_sha256: Projectctl content_hash: same canonical encoding but excludes the top-level content_sha256 field to avoid a self-reference.
hash_definitions.scenario_and_snapshot_pins: revised_scenario_sha256, test_catalogue_sha256, binding_sha256 and offline_workflow_fixture_sha256 use canonical JSON payload hashing, not file bytes.
